description: Remove unused code, dead dependencies, and commented-out code throughout the codebase. Clean up files that are no longer referenced by any active code path.
steps: Remove pages/index.tsx - it is fully redundant since next.config.mjs redirects '/' to '/stations'. All functionality lives in pages/stations/index.tsx.
Remove pages/api/hello.ts - default Next.js boilerplate API route, never used.
Remove components/Tooltip.tsx - not imported anywhere in the codebase.
Remove components/LoginModel.tsx and components/RegisterModel.tsx - all auth/login functionality is commented out throughout the app. These components are only imported from each other.
Remove components/NotificationHandler.tsx - imported in layout.tsx but never rendered (usage is commented out).
Remove the NotificationHandler import from components/layout.tsx.
Remove utils/ogUrlGenerator.ts - not imported or referenced anywhere.
Remove utils/themeUtils.ts - not imported or referenced anywhere.

Remove utils/oneSignalConfig.tsx and utils/permissions.tsx - OneSignal push notification code. Only called from _app.tsx (initializeOneSignal). Remove the OneSignal initialization from pages/_app.tsx as well.

Remove lib/convexStore.ts - the Zustand store. It is imported in pages/stations/[id].tsx and pages/cameras/index.tsx but the actual useUserStore() calls are all commented out, with hardcoded replacements (isLoggedIn = false, favStations = []). Remove all commented-out useUserStore imports and references from pages/stations/index.tsx, pages/stations/[id].tsx, pages/cameras/index.tsx.
Remove the 'zustand' dependency from package.json.
Remove the 'pulltorefreshjs' and '@types/pulltorefreshjs' devDependencies from package.json - they are never imported (the app has a custom usePullToRefresh hook instead).
Remove the 'react-onesignal' dependency from package.json.
Remove the '@auth/core' and '@convex-dev/auth' dependencies from package.json - auth is fully commented out. Also remove the useAuthActions import from anywhere it appears but is not used.
Remove the 'dotenv' dependency from package.json - it is not used in a Next.js app (env vars are handled by Next.js).

Remove the '@vercel/analytics' dependency from package.json and the <Analytics /> component usage in layout.tsx. Remove '@vercel/speed-insights' and the <SpeedInsights /> usage in _app.tsx. (The app deploys on Netlify, not Vercel.)
Remove convex/auth.ts, convex/auth.config.ts, convex/favorites.ts - all auth-related Convex backend code that is unused.
Remove the authTables import and usage from convex/schema.ts, and remove the favoriteStations and favoriteCameras table definitions since favorites/auth are removed.
Clean up all remaining commented-out code blocks related to auth, login, favorites, and OneSignal throughout the active pages and components.
Remove the old migration docs that are no longer relevant: CONVEX_MIGRATION.md, MIGRATION_STATUS.md, migration_plan.md.

Remove services/ directory - contains scraping scripts (cameraImgDownloader.js, cameraUpdater.js, stationUpdater.js, waterLevelUpdater.js) that are standalone Node scripts not part of the frontend app.
Remove the generateKeys.mjs file - one-time script for generating auth keys, no longer needed.
Remove the deno.lock file - not a Deno project.
Run npm install to update package-lock.json after dependency removals.
Run npm run build to verify the app still builds cleanly after all removals.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no errors
npm run lint passes (or has only pre-existing warnings)
No unused imports remain in active files
No commented-out code blocks longer than 2 lines remain in active source files
All removed files are actually gone from the filesystem
The app structure is clean: only actively-used code remains
verification: cd ~/water-level && npm install && npm run build
findings: All unused files, dead dependencies, and commented-out code removed. 30+ files deleted, 9 dependencies removed.
